points.label: What Jesus supplies
points.left: John calls Jesus the Lamb of God, recalls why he baptized, says he did not recognize him, and names the descending and remaining Spirit as the given sign.
points.right: After hearing of Christ’s works, John sends disciples to ask whether Jesus is the coming one; Jesus answers with observed healings, resurrection, and good news.

payload.posture: Inspect both Scripture WEBU sources while preserving their speakers, setting, sequence, and distinct claims about John.
